Follow me and comment «CHINA» and I’ll send you the full breakdown of the model Chinese researchers used to beat every published method.

Everyone’s talking about Chinese quant funds.

57% returns. 73% returns. Double what Western funds made.

Most people stop at the headlines.

They don’t ask how.

I dug through the research coming out of Shanghai Jiao Tong University. Found a paper called MASTER. A stock transformer that rewires itself based on market conditions.

Calm market? It focuses on individual stocks.

Volatility spikes? It shifts to cross-stock correlations.

This isn’t some black box. The code is open source. The paper is public. The architecture is explained.

The best quant research right now isn’t coming from Stanford.

It’s coming from Shanghai.

If you want the full breakdown, comment «CHINA.»

Inside your smartphone there is a hidden system most people never think about. It’s called the baseband processor. This is the chip responsible for handling cellular communication — calls, SMS, 4G, 5G, and constant communication with nearby cell towers.
Unlike apps or the operating system, the baseband runs independently and is always active as long as your phone has signal.
Here’s where it gets interesting.
Your phone constantly receives low-level network messages from cell towers: registration updates, handover commands, signaling packets, and other control data. The baseband firmware parses and processes these messages automatically.
If there is a vulnerability in how the baseband handles certain malformed or specially crafted packets, an attacker could exploit it. By sending a malicious cellular signal or manipulating network signaling traffic, the attacker may trigger memory corruption inside the baseband firmware. In advanced scenarios, this can lead to remote code execution.
That means code could run inside the cellular processor without the user clicking anything — no link, no download, no interaction.
In extremely rare but high-impact cases, researchers have demonstrated that baseband exploits could potentially allow:
Intercepting communications
Tracking device identifiers
Disrupting cellular connectivity
Or pivoting toward the main operating system
These attacks are highly sophisticated and usually require deep telecom knowledge or access to specialized infrastructure. They are not typical “script-kiddie” hacks.
The key takeaway:
Your phone has multiple layers. Even if you never open a suspicious app, the cellular layer is still exposed to network signals at all times.
This is why keeping your device updated matters — baseband firmware updates are often included in system security patches, even if you never see them.
#cybersecurity #networksecurity #networks

node.text:
Newly released DOJ footage. The final minute of Jeffrey Epstein’s interview with Steve Bannon.

Epstein had just used “The Devil” in a metaphor to justify his crimes. Bannon asks: “Do you think you’re the devil himself?”

57 seconds of micro-expressions. Contradictory affect. Duper’s Delight. And a man who walks away smiling.

The full written investigation into Epstein’s network is live now on Patreon. Link in bio.

Source: U.S. Department of Justice, Epstein Files Transparency Act (EFTA01600824, Data Set 10).

The video essay is coming.

Follow @zeroday.security 

The modern world constantly generates signals — from ships and aircraft to conflicts, cyber threats, and geopolitical activity. These platforms collect and visualize open-source intelligence (OSINT), allowing anyone to observe global events, infrastructure, and security developments in real time.
From satellite intelligence and conflict tracking to live cyber threat monitoring, these websites show how much information is publicly available when you know where to look.

node.text: Yeh musalmano key demg say qail raha hai

امریکی کانگریس میں عمران خان کی رہائی کے لیے 60 سے زائد  اسرائیل نواز  اراکین نے لابنگ شروع کر رکھی ہے  ہے، جن میں سے کچھ معروف اراکین کے نام یہ ہیں:
- *گریگ کیسار* (Greg Casar)
- *جم میک گوورن* (Jim McGovern)
- *سمر لی* (Summer Lee)
- *باربرا لی* (Barbara Lee)
- *راجہ کرشنا مورتی* (Raja Krishnamoorthi)
- *الیگزینڈریا اوکاسیو کورٹیز* (Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez)
- *راؤ کھنا* (Ro Khanna)
- *رشدہ طلیب* (Rashida Tlaib)
- *الہان ​​عمر* (Ilhan Omar)
ان اراکین میں ایک بڑی تعداد کٹر زائنسٹ  اسرائیل نواز صہیونی ہیں ۔دوسری جانب
 برطانوی پارلیمنٹ کے 20 سے زائد ارکان نے عمران خان کی رہائی کے لیے خط لکھا ہے۔ ان ارکان میں شامل ہیں:
-  زیک گولڈ اسمتھ  نسل پرست یہودی لارڈ طارق احمد ۔۔قادیانی جماعت برطانیہ کا نائب صدر رہا ہے
_کم جانسن_, پاؤلا بارکر, اپسانہ بیگم, لیام برن, روزی ڈفیلڈ, گل فرنس, پاؤلیٹ ہیملٹن, پیٹر لیمب, اینڈی میکڈونلڈ, ابتسام محمد, بیل ریبیرو ایڈی, زارہ سلطانہ, اسٹیو ویدرڈن, نادیہ وٹوم
- 
_بیرونس جان بیک ویل_, بیرونس کرسٹین بلور, پیٹر ہین, جان ہینڈی, ٹوڈوانفی شامل ہیں کیا آج برطانیہ اور امریکہ میں طاقت کے ایوانوں میں موجود صہیونی زائنسٹ اسلام سے محبت میں عمران کی رہائ کی مہم چلارہے ہیں؟

Elie Habib built “World Monitor,” an open-source dashboard designed to cut through geopolitical noise by replacing dozens of scattered tabs with one real-time intelligence screen. 

Aggregating 20+ live data sources, it tracks everything from news velocity and prediction markets to military activity, infrastructure, internet outages, and global disruptions. 

The tool focuses on correlation over clutter — detecting when stories converge, markets move early, or unusual patterns emerge. 

In an era where crises are interconnected and information overload is the norm, World Monitor aims to give analysts, journalists, and decision-makers a faster, clearer signal on what actually matters.

#Geopolitics #OpenSource #DataIntelligence #OSINT #GlobalRisk @eliehabib

People often ask what it was really like back then. Honestly, it was like chai going cold because we wouldn’t stop talking. It was showing up tired and leaving inspired. It was Naumaan slipping into Punjabi as soon as he got comfortable, cracking jokes that went completely over my head. I never understood a word, but his laugh was so contagious, I’d be in tears anyway. It was Humayun turning tear-jerkers into comedy that made us reshoot the scene. And it was the three of us, somehow becoming a little piece of each other’s story. Naumaan, Humayun, and I feel lucky to be standing with these legends in the frame. Style may change, but charisma lasts forever!

What if you could run a full penetration test, gather deep OSINT, and even crack passwords without ever opening your laptop? 🤯

In my latest video, I show you exactly how to build a personal AI hacker assistant using the OpenClaw framework running on Kali Linux. The best part? You can control the entire infrastructure securely from your phone using a simple messaging app like Telegram.

Swipe through to see how this agentic AI setup works, how it spawns sub-agents to multitask, and how it delivers professional vulnerability reports right to your chat. 📄⚡️

👇 Want to build this yourself? Click the link in our bio to watch the full, step-by-step tutorial on YouTube!

Federal officials have arrested a California man who was shot by US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents and charged him with “assault” on a federal officer.

Carlos Ivan Mendoza Hernandez, 36, was shot by ICE officers on 7 April in Patterson, a rural town in California’s central valley roughly 80 miles south-east of San Francisco. He was hit by more than six bullets, including in the face, according to his attorney.

Hernandez is the latest person to be injured by immigration officers and then criminally prosecuted by the US Department of Justice (DoJ). In the Los Angeles region, the DoJ has consistently failed to win convictions against people accused of assaulting immigration officers, suffering a string of embarrassing dismissals and acquittals in recent months.

في اليابان، يتم استخدام البلاطات الكهروضغطية (piezoelectric tiles) لتحويل حركة المشي إلى كهرباء. هذه البلاطات تلتقط الطاقة الحركية الناتجة أثناء المشي. عندما يمشي شخص فوقها، يتسبب وزنه في انضغاط طفيف في البلاطة، مما يولد ضغطًا ميكانيكيًا (mechanical stress). المادة الكهروضغطية داخل البلاطة تحول هذا الضغط إلى كهرباء. كل خطوة تولد كمية صغيرة من الشحنة الكهربائية (electric charge)، ومع ملايين الخطوات يتم إنتاج كمية كافية من الكهرباء لتشغيل مصابيح LED. في أماكن مثل محطات شيبويا، يساهم حوالي 2.4 مليون خطوة يوميًا في هذا النظام. يمكن تخزين هذه الكهرباء أو استخدامها مباشرة، مما يقلل الاعتماد على مصادر الطاقة التقليدية.

node.text: Ahh u r looking so gorgeous as alwayssss

I’ve received so many messages of love and support from you all, and I truly can’t thank you enough. Every message, every prayer, every kind word has meant more than you know.

In a time when I genuinely needed support, you showed up for me and sometimes, words alone are more than enough.

I took a little time to gather my thoughts and process everything properly before responding. I believe in speaking with clarity, not emotion because I know the truth can neither be punished nor silenced.
I wanna know the update on this!😭
So proud of you for not backing down! ❤️More power to you girl👑
Allah Almighty stands with the truthful, and exposes the evil. That alone is enough to give women strength and courage to defend your character, and dignity. This is our armour. Proud of you🙌
I wanna know the update on this!😭

node.text: There was a case where an IO harassed my client unreasonably, taking away his ID card. We filed a written application to SP/IG/CPO and received a response the third day. He was called to the station where my team went along with him, he was given back his ID and the IO himself apologised. We didn’t have to involve courts. Although courts are a much powerful relief when departments don’t listen! #pakistanlaw #legal #police
Complain kis number par karni hai 1787 he hai nah
Ap or hum sab janta hai through media k ground reality kia hai ap kia samjhti hain marryum nhi janti hoge
Written application sy kia hoga wahan bhi to marryum ka he log hain yeh sab kbi bhi kisi ki help nhi kryga yahan law and order system hai he nhi yahan jangel ka qanoon hai bibi

Useless baat, aik badameezi ko sabit kerne k liye lakhon rupay lawyer ko dedo, saal-ha-saal adaalat k chakar katte raho, na wph Police wala fire kiya jaye ga aut na koi action hoga, ulta IG, SP sabk sabis bande k khilaf ho jain ge
Kuch faida nahi hai bhai insa bas bate kar wa sakta hai ya bas takes.lena jante hai or insai ship.mai phase bande to bachae nahi jarahe hai sare chor or khabess bhate hue hamare mulk.mai
پاکستان کے پولیس کبھی بھی بدل نہیں سکتی ان کا رویہ اسی طرح کا ہے گا یہ سب کہنے کی باتیں ہیں کہ اب کوئی بھی پولیس والا کسی کو بدتمیزی سے نہیں بلائے گا

My point isn't about the politics of the war—it's about the logic of the scapegoat. 📉

The closure of the Strait of Hormuz is a massive economic event. History shows us a clear pattern: whenever there is global financial pain (like rising oil prices and inflation), societies often look for an easy target to blame. I mentioned the blockade to explain why we are seeing a 'wave of hate' right now. It's not a conspiracy; it’s a classic historical reaction to economic stress. ⚖️🌐 #Geopolitics #History #economy

China just made history. 🇨🇳⚛️
For years, the quantum computing race was all about hardware. Who has the most qubits. Who has the fastest processor. Who can build the biggest machine.
China just changed the rules entirely.
Origin Pilot — China’s first quantum computer operating system — is now publicly downloadable by anyone, anywhere on Earth. For free.
Let that sink in.
IBM has quantum computers. Google has quantum computers. Both are powerful. Both are impressive. Neither made their operating system publicly downloadable.
China just did.
Think of Origin Pilot as Windows — but for quantum computers. It manages qubits, schedules quantum tasks, calibrates hardware automatically, and runs across multiple chip types: superconducting, trapped ions, neutral atoms. One unified system. Zero dependency on American technology.
This is the world’s first open-source quantum OS available for local download.
But here’s what makes this truly massive — this isn’t just a software release. It’s a geopolitical strategy.
By going open-source, China is inviting universities, researchers, and developers worldwide to build their quantum future on Chinese infrastructure.
Quantum technology is explicitly listed in China’s 2026–2030 national development plan.
Whoever controls the operating system controls the ecosystem.
The quantum software race just began. China is already leading.

📚 Sources: Global Times, Anhui Quantum Computing Engineering Research Center, Origin Quantum, Physical Review Letters 2026

👉 Follow @uncover.quantum for more quantum breakthroughs! ⚛️

node.text:
One day, I missed her.

Missed her in a way that made me feel like my day would’ve been better if she were around.
Like my meals would’ve felt more wholesome if she were sitting across from me.
Like my workouts would’ve been more fun and less of a punishment if she were doing them with me.
Like I needed her - just to feel that sense of home and calm, no matter where I was.

So,

I made my best friend… my wife. 😀❤️

node.text:
Hi my loves, 

Introducing to you now “My Husband”! 💘

Mr. Vijay Deverakonda!! ❤️

The man who taught me what true love feels like, 
The man who showed me what being in peace feels like! 🤍
The man who told me everyday that dreaming big was absolutely ok and constantly telling me I was capable of achieving something much more than what I could possibly think I ever could! 🤍

The man who’s never stopped me from dancing like no one’s watching.. 
the man who showed me travelling with friends is the best thing ever, and trust me I could write a book on this man! 🤍

I’ve become the woman I have always dreamt of being, because you made her who she is today! 
I’ve truly been blessed! 🤍

Vijju I am always short of words to describe the feelings I have for you!! I’ve always told you that!! 
But you know suddenly all of my achievements, struggles, happiness, sadness, joy, life - everything just makes a lot more sense now - it is because I have you - witnessing it all.. being the biggest part of it all! ❤️

I am so so so so soooo excited to becoming your wife! to be your wife! To be called your wife!! 💃🏻💃🏻❤️ it’s full party time now!!💃🏻❤️

Let’s have the bestestest life ever together! 
I love you! ❤️

Standing at the station again, on my way to work.
Some mornings feel heavy, but I remind myself why I started.
I’m not where I want to be yet, but I’m proud I keep showing up.
One step, one train, one day at a time.

The 2023 Bohemian Grove leak provides a rare window into one of the world’s most secretive retreats, an annual gathering in Sonoma County, California, where some of the most powerful men in politics, business, and culture convene. Founded in the 19th century as a private, all-male social club, the Bohemian Grove is best known for its midsummer encampments, which combine elaborate theatrical rituals with informal networking among elite attendees. The 2023 roster reportedly includes prominent political figures such as Edwin Meese III, former U.S. Attorney General; Carlos Bea, U.S. Court of Appeals judge; Bobby Inman, retired admiral and former NSA director; and Paul Pelosi, venture capitalist and spouse of former House Speaker Nancy Pelosi, highlighting the Grove’s enduring attraction to legal, legislative, and intelligence elites. Alongside these policymakers, cultural figures like Ken Burns, the acclaimed documentarian, Jimmy Buffett, iconic musician, and Jim Belushi, actor and comedian, are listed, demonstrating the club’s unique blend of fame, influence, and leisure. Business leaders also dominate the roster, from members of the Bechtel and Mondavi families to executives at Franklin Templeton and Wells Fargo, reflecting the intersection of wealth, politics, and social capital. While many attendees are lesser-known, the roster reveals a pattern of discreet networking where powerful judges, legislators, intelligence officials, corporate leaders, and entertainers mingle away from public scrutiny. The leak reinforces the perception of Bohemian Grove as an elite enclave where alliances form, ideas circulate, and influence consolidates, all under a veil of privacy. Despite the list’s publication, the club maintains strict secrecy, never confirming membership or attendance, leaving outsiders with only glimpses of a world where social, political, and financial power quietly intersect each summer.

node.text:
Day 85/100. Comment report and I’ll send the article over.

This research paper is getting passed around by a bunch of my tech + investor friends.

It’s from Citrini Research, and it lays out a pretty unsettling thesis:

if AI actually succeeds, it could trigger a nasty economic feedback loop.

I’m bullish on AI long-term. I think it can make people better off.

But it’s still worth thinking through the downside.

Here’s the loop:

1) AI gets better → companies cut white-collar jobs
2) Less income → less spending → companies lose revenue
3) Companies invest even more in AI to cut costs
4) AI gets better → more jobs get cut → repeat

And if people can’t find comparable work, they burn savings, take lower-pay jobs… and the financial system starts to strain.

To not have an exceptionally long video, I split this into two parts — follow for part 2.

Appreciate @atlasberry008 for the inspiration for the video. Sending credit his way!

.

If you are tired of AI agents that just sit there waiting for you to type a prompt, you need to see OpenFang. It’s an "Agent OS" where you spin up autonomous workers—they call them "Hands"—to continuously map out research, scrape data, or generate leads on a schedule. You set the parameters, and they just run. I have to respect the developer flex here: it’s a 137,000-line Rust codebase, shipped as a single binary, with literally zero Clippy warnings. If you're on OpenClaw already, there's a one-command migration. 

https://github.com/RightNow-AI/openfang

#github #opensource

node.text:
Several women’s rights activists, including Aurat March members, were detained by police in Islamabad ahead of a rally they planned to hold on the occasion of International Women’s Day on Sunday.

Police sources told Dawn that they were detained near Super Market in Sector F-6. They had planned to reach the National Press Club, but a huge contingent of police was already present there, which arrested the marchers and took them to the Women’s Police Station.

The Women’s Police Station released a list of 19 women activists of Aurat March. Those detained include prominent activist Dr Farzana Bari, two of her daughters, and human rights defender Tahira Abdullah, along with other Aurat March organisers and participants, police sources confirmed.

Aside from women activists, several participants, including men, were also detained by the police for participating in the march.

For more, visit the link in our bio.

मैं माधुर्य दास, जोरहाट assam का एक साधारण युवक हूँ। मेरी आँखों में बस एक ही सपना है— 2028 के ओलंपिक में भारतीय जर्सी पहनकर देश का प्रतिनिधित्व करना।
लेकिन सपना जितना बड़ा है, हकीकत उतनी ही कठिन है। आज आर्थिक तंगी मेरे पैरों की बेड़ियाँ बन गई है। जिस उम्र में एक खिलाड़ी को बेहतर ट्रेनिंग और पौष्टिक आहार की जरूरत होती है, उस समय मैं अकेले अपने घर के आँगन में पसीना बहा रहा हूँ। मैं जानता हूँ कि सिर्फ घर पर वर्कआउट करके ओलंपिक तक पहुँचना असंभव है, लेकिन मेरे पास कोई विकल्प नहीं है।
सब लोग मेरे उत्साह का मजाक उड़ाते हैं, कोई मेरी जिद को नहीं समझता। लेकिन मैं हार मानने वालों में से नहीं हूँ। मुझे बस एक सही कोच (Coach) की मदद चाहिए। आज मेरा हाथ थामकर आगे ले जाने वाला कोई नहीं है। आप मेरी आखिरी उम्मीद हैं। एक साहसी व्यक्ति के नाते मैं आपसे अनुरोध करता हूँ— मुझे एक मौका दीजिए। मैं आपसे वादा करता हूँ, मैं कर दिखाऊँगा। अपना खून-पसीना एक करके भी मैं देश के लिए गौरव हासिल करूँगा।
मुझे दया नहीं, बस थोड़ी मदद चाहिए ताकि मैं अपने सपने की ओर बढ़ सकूँ।

node.text:
Your mouse isn’t just tracking movement — it’s doing real-time image processing.

Inside every optical mouse there’s a LED and a tiny CMOS camera. The LED illuminates the surface, and the camera captures thousands of microscopic images every second of the texture under your mouse.

These images are sent to a DSP (Digital Signal Processor) inside the mouse, which runs a cross-correlation algorithm to compare consecutive frames and detect how the texture pattern shifts.

That shift becomes movement data (counts), which the computer converts into cursor motion.

That’s also where DPI (Dots Per Inch) comes in — it defines how many movement counts are generated for every inch the mouse travels. Higher DPI means more counts per inch, so the cursor reacts to even smaller physical movements.

From microscopic surface patterns → mathematical correlation → cursor movement.

Your mouse is basically a tiny computer vision system.

node.text: The Bloomberg Terminal MAP’s visuals are cool to look at, but not useful for modeling + trading. Their underlying datasets are what underpin energy trading strategies at top firms globally. Energy traders build extremely complex and nuanced models of end to end flow, anticipating how and when supply will impact market prices, and trading calendar and other spreads around this. #quant #bloombergterminal #futurestrading #economics
most expensive tool for a reason
All of this still can’t make 30% a year 😂
Unprecedented levels of monitoring the situation
the map function was soo much fun at my internship

Hey everyone! 😊
I’m a small handmade jewelry maker — I design minimalist hoop earrings, dainty stud earrings, and elegant rings that are great for everyday wear or gifting 💍✨. I’ve been trying to focus on pieces that feel timeless yet stylish, and I’d love some honest feedback from this community on what styles you think are trending right now.
Here’s my Etsy shop if you want to take a quick look:
➡️ https://elyndraluxuryjewelry.etsy.com/
I’d especially love to hear:
✨ Which designs you think women are loving most these days
✨ What price range feels right for handmade jewelry
✨ Any tips for better photography or presentation
Really appreciate any thoughts or suggestions — thank you! 🤍
https://elyndraluxuryjewelry.etsy.com/

Video editing was tougher than the code 😭

Built GeoTrade : live at www.web-code.tech

Instead of relying on tons of external open Ai  APIs, most of the intelligence runs through a local ML pipeline.

News from sources like Reuters and Bloomberg flows into an NLP stack that performs: 
• transformer-based event classification 
• sentiment analysis for geopolitical stress 
• clustering to detect emerging macro narratives 

These signals are aggregated into a Geopolitical Tension Index, which then feeds a LightGBM model predicting things like volatility spikes, bullish/bearish bias, and macro risk shifts.

The frontend visualizes everything on a live world map — click any continent to see the event and its possible market impact. Currently fixing a few too-many-requests issues because the demo got a bit more traffic than expected causing it to fall back to demo data. 

Register your email if you like it.#tech #ai

Comment “REPO” if you want the link to download these agents into your next project!  This is The largest collection of AI coding skills

860+ skills. One repo. Works everywhere.

→ Claude Code
→ Gemini CLI
→ Codex CLI
→ Cursor
→ GitHub Copilot
→ OpenCode
→ Antigravity IDE
→ AdaL CLI

What are skills?

AI agents are smart but generic. They don’t know your deployment protocol. They don’t know your company’s architecture patterns. They don’t know AWS CloudFormation syntax.

Skills are small markdown files that teach them.

One skill = one capability. Perfectly executed. Every time.

This repo has 860 of them:

→ Architecture (system design, ADRs, C4)
→ Security (AppSec, pentesting, compliance)
→ DevOps (Docker, AWS, Vercel, CI/CD)
→ Data & AI (RAG, agents, LangGraph)
→ Testing (TDD, QA workflows)
→ Business (SEO, pricing, copywriting)

Install once:

npx antigravity-awesome-skills

Then:

“Use @ brainstorming to plan a SaaS MVP.”
“Run @ lint-and-validate on this file.”

Your AI agent just got 860 new capabilities.

node.text:
🙋‍♂️
.
.
.
IF THE US WANTS GREENLAND, GERMANY HAS TO WAKE UP. 🇩🇪💥🧊

The "Art of the Deal" just turned into the "Battle for the Arctic." 🇺🇸🗺️

Denmark has already said Greenland is not for sale. But if Washington decides to push—economically or strategically—Copenhagen can't hold the line alone.
The safety of Europe’s borders now rests on one question: Will the Sleeping Giant finally wake up? 🇪🇺💤

The Reality Check:
For decades, Germany has been Europe’s banker, but not its bodyguard. 💶🚫💂‍♂️
But you can't defend the Arctic with a checkbook.
If Europe wants to protect its sovereignty against a superpower US, Berlin has to shift gears from "Economic Powerhouse" to "Military Backbone." 🏗️➡️🔫

The Scenario:
Imagine German Eurofighters patrolling the skies over Nuuk alongside the RAF. ✈️❄️
It sounds crazy, but the world map is changing fast. If Europe stays asleep, it might wake up a lot smaller. 📉

The Question: 
Does Germany have the guts to lead a European defense against the US? 🤨🇩🇪👇 Tell us your prediction!

I am very grateful that the job that I performed while deployed did not lead to any harm to Iraqis. 

We have to stop the war machine that is the United States. 

#trump #usa #iran #war #veteransagainsttrump
I started to realize that too

Millions protested the invasion plans around the world.  You ignored peace activists and fervently joined a racist call to arms. Zero sympathy for all zealots and cannon fodder. I coild have but i didnt fkn join up.. huh....

❤️Congratulations to you that you had achieved something, REALIZATION, use your new wisdom to help those who need helping, but most of all take care of yourself first. We are sure you are living a meaningful and fulfilling life after your REALIZATION.

Somebody finally said it. I feel bad for families and friends who lose their loved ones over this quest to find this made up terrorists when all the search is doing is to terrorize people in their own country and dictate how they should live while stealing their resources and feeding innocent people lies just to feed propaganda and hate to the gullible supremacists
I started to realize that too

A 27-second video from GGDSD College in Chandigarh shows female students performing an energetic, synchronized dance during a Holi celebration on campus. The students are seen dancing with coordinated hip movements and arm gestures as colorful powder fills the air and a cheering crowd watches. The video, set to upbeat music, has gone viral on social media, sparking mixed reactions and debate over changing campus culture and traditions in universities.

🇯🇵📈 عندما تصل إلى هذه السرعة، لن يكون الأمر وكأنك تتحرك على اليابسة، بل كأنك تسافر بسرعة الصوت 🌍🚀.
تُظهر هذه المحاكاة كيف سيكون الشعور بالسفر عبر اليابان باستخدام قطار فائق السرعة يسير بسرعة ماخ 1، أي حوالي 1330 كيلومترًا في الساعة.
حاليًا، يعمل أسرع قطار في اليابان بسرعة تقارب 320 كيلومترًا في الساعة، لذلك فإن القطار فائق السرعة سيكون أسرع بأكثر من أربع مرات، مما قد يغير مفهوم السفر البري بالكامل ويجعل التنقل بين المدن يتم في وقت قصير جدًا.

📍🇮🇷 Khamenei has been confirmed killed in an Israeli Air Force strike on his compound.

This marks the end of an era that has defined Iran and much of the Middle East for nearly half a century.

For 47 years, Ali Khamenei stood as the central figure of the Islamic Republic, shaping its ideology, suppressing dissent, and directing regional conflicts. Now, on the very first day of this war, reports suggest the man who ruled Iran with absolute authority is gone.

This is not just another battlefield development, it fundamentally changes everything: the psychological balance of the conflict, the future of the regime, and the trajectory of Iran itself.

node.text: لاہور کے علاقے DHA فیز 6 میں واقع Doubleshot میں دو خواتین کے درمیان تلخ کلامی کا واقعہ پیش آیا، جس کی ویڈیوز سوشل میڈیا پر گردش کر رہی ہیں۔ عینی شاہدین کے مطابق موقع پر موجود افراد صورتحال کو سنبھالنے کے بجائے ویڈیوز بناتے رہے۔ تاحال اس واقعے پر لاہور پولیس کی جانب سے کسی باضابطہ کارروائی یا گرفتاری کی تصدیق سامنے نہیں آئی، جس پر شہریوں کی جانب سے تشویش کا اظہار کیا جا رہا ہے
Lanat ho tum log kisi larkiyo ka larta howa tamasha dekh raha ho or keh raha ho kamal kamal lanat ho tum jesa mardo pr 🤬

node.text:
In the clip, the fan signals for the ball like she’s already predicting where the shot is going. The batter launches a massive hit, the ball sails straight into the crowd… and somehow it lands right at her feet. No scramble, no chaos — just perfect placement like the cricket gods personally delivered it. 🤯📈
And here’s the funny part: in many T20 leagues, fans who catch a six in the stands can actually win prize money or sponsor rewards depending on the match promotion at the time. So what started as a playful “pass me the ball” moment suddenly feels like manifestation with financial benefits.
Naturally, the comment section is loving it. Some fans are calling it the luckiest seat in the stadium, while others are joking that she clearly knew where the ball was going before the batter even swung.
Because in cricket, sometimes the real winners of a six… aren’t even on the field. 😭🏏
.
